decisions.reason: The GA4 plugin implements the only remaining Google analytics standard, embodies sunk development effort, and anchors the firm's publicly stated focus on measurable, analytics-driven results.

Interface development is a claimed core competence and the plugin underpins the integration side of the full-service promise, so management attributes any modest uptake to a normal ramp-up rather than failure.
The relaunch SEO service has its own page, is central to the firm's shop-relaunch positioning, and draws on existing staff at little marginal cost, so there is no reason to abandon it.

The newly launched SEO workshops are visibly committed on their own page and fit the firm's marketing expertise, so it is too early to judge them and disappointing early demand can still be read as temporary.
